chunks: As well as his wife and children.

key_terms.صَاحِبَتِهِ: His wife (specifically referring to the Prophet's spouse)

ai.seo_question: Who are the 'wife and children' referred to in the Quranic verses concerning the Prophet's family?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase is frequently interpreted as referring to the Ahl al-Bayt, specifically linking the 'wife' to Hazrat Fatimah al-Zahra (peace be upon her) and the 'offspring' to the Imams, thereby establishing their unique spiritual authority. This interpretation underscores the concept of Ismah (infallibility) and divine selection, distinguishing them from the general companions and affirming their role as the primary source of guidance after the Prophet.
